_design: Layer 15 — Capability Model. The 4th axis of the domain taxonomy (after functional/module/process). Reflects the process+code+conformance work structurally: a domain is 'understood' only when 10 capability dimensions are covered for it (S precondition + A-H understanding + R composite readiness). ALIGN (re-express every domain on one skeleton) then EXPAND (every weak cell is the ranked roadmap). THIS FILE IS THE SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the matrix — do not hand-copy the matrix into prose docs (it drifts). Born Session #079.

_strata.note: A domain is a PAIR, not one model. The product lives in the delta. Capability G = compare AS_RUN against AS_DESIGNED. Conformance has TWO preconditions per domain: the standard baseline AND our process. Capturing AS_DESIGNED per domain is itself a precondition capability (S_STANDARD_REF below), mostly NONE today.
_strata.AS_DESIGNED: how SAP designed the domain — normative reference flow/objects/config as delivered (SAP Best Practices / PaPM reference content)
_strata.AS_RUN: how UNESCO actually does it — real process from data + Z-code/config/exits/.NET apps/workflows on top
_strata.DELTA: G_CONFORMANCE — where AS_RUN extends/deviates from AS_DESIGNED, down to the implementing object (the custom-over-standard x-ray)

E_AUTH.question: who can/does execute it (roles, users, SoD)?
E_AUTH.method: VERIFIED (RES-AUTH-SOD wwyujjqyk): role model AGR_DEFINE/AGR_USERS(validity)/AGR_TCODES/AGR_1251(obj+field LOW/HIGH)/AGR_AGRS/AGR_1016; users USR01/02/04/12, UST12; SU24 proposals USOBT_C(values)+USOBX_C(OKFLAG N/X/Y); TSTCA(start-tcode auth). SoD = Function(tcodes+auth objects) -> Risk(2+ conflicting functions), 3 risk types (SoD/Critical Action/Critical Permission), action+permission levels. Expand AGR_USERS->AGR_1251 for effective role auth. CAVEAT: SU24/USOBX_C is a PROPOSAL, not enforcement — real check only where code has AUTHORITY-CHECK (pair with code scan / ST01-STAUTHTRACE). E_AUTH.split_d01_p01: role STRUCTURE (AGR_DEFINE/AGR_1251/USOBT_C/TSTCA) = D01 -> ROLE-level SoD without P01; user ASSIGNMENTS (AGR_USERS/USR02/UST12) = P01 -> USER-level SoD gated

U_USAGE.question: WHAT objects actually execute, WHO runs them, by which CHANNEL (dialog / batch / RFC-BAPI / batch-input BDC), WHEN, and at what VOLUME — the AS-RUN execution footprint?
U_USAGE.method: Fuse the execution-evidence channels into a per-domain object×actor×channel×time×volume census: RSAU/SM20 audit (Transaction Start->tcode, Report Start->program, RFC Function Call->function) + TBTCO/TBTCP (batch program+variant) + APQI/APQD (batch input / BDC). Cross-reference the static catalog (TSTC / TFDIR) to split EXECUTED vs CATALOG-ONLY. Builder: process_mining/fm_executed_census.py (generalize per domain via the FM-style name filter). Scored: NONE=no census; PARTIAL=one channel or counts-only; HAVE=all 4 channels with actor+volume(+time).
U_USAGE.note: The AS-RUN usage layer. Distinct from B_CODE (STATIC: which code exists), A_PROCESS (the FLOW/variants) and E_AUTH (who CAN execute). U_USAGE = who ACTUALLY executes what, how, when, how much. Bridges static inventory -> live reality; the dead-vs-used signal also feeds R_S4_READINESS (used-to-migrate vs dead-to-delete). Added 2026-06-23 on user directive ('otra dimension del process discovery: que se usa, quien, como, cuando, volumen').

systemic_gaps.finding: NONE for every domain — we never captured the SAP as-designed baseline. This is the PRECONDITION for G: without the standard reference there is nothing to conform AS-RUN against. This is why G is empty everywhere. Capture standard baselines (PaPM/Best-Practices) per domain FIRST.
NONE for every domain — Auth/SoD is a missing MODEL capability, not a per-domain gap. Closing it once lifts all domains.
NONE for every domain — the custom-over-standard x-ray (the differentiator) is unbuilt; AS-RUN vs AS-DESIGNED delta. Start on strongest rows (Payment, P2P) where PaPM/standard baselines exist.

NONE for every domain — S/4HANA migration readiness not yet APPLIED, though the method is fully VERIFIED (ATC S4HANA_READINESS + Simplification DB + Custom Code Migration app + usage scoping, research #3). Commercial hook (migration x-ray). Largely D01-runnable; usage scoping needs P01.

expansion_order: 1. Close E (Auth/SoD) once — highest leverage, lifts every domain (AGR_*/SU24/SUIM).
2. Close G (Conformance) on Payment + P2P first (baselines exist) — the differentiator.
3. Fill A (Process) for high-H/low-A domains: PSM/FM, Closing — turn known opportunity into discovered as-is.
4. Build F (file/variant) across Integration + batch-heavy domains — the OWN additions.
5. Apply R_S4_READINESS — run ATC S4HANA_READINESS + Simplification items + usage scoping per domain (method verified; mostly D01-runnable). The migration x-ray / commercial hook.
